checks.evidence: RoomPlacement.swift:11,56-64 rejects nonfinite or out-of-range dimensions/optional ceiling, dimensions below 1 or above 30 meters, subjects outside inclusive room extents, and nonfinite/out-of-range yaw.

dimensionRangePreserving bounds the edit range without changing the subject, falls back safely for invalid offsets; testResizeRangesPreserveSubjectWithoutSilentRelocation asserts unchanged coordinates.

checks.outcome: source reviewed; consistent with documented convention
checks.evidence: RoomPlacement.swift:298-311 subtracts scene subject X/Z, applies a yaw rotation, and adds measured subject X/Z. Positive yaw maps scene +Z toward room +X. Room subject maps to the measured subject coordinates. No scaling or clamping occurs.

RoomPlacement.swift:307 preserves absolute studio-floor Y. insideRoom tests only the floor projection as documented. RoomVerticalClearance independently reports below-floor or above-ceiling centers; unmeasured ceiling does not claim full vertical containment.

Scene.swift Position.isValid requires finite coordinates in -100...100. RoomPlacementPlan validates the scene before subtraction; horizontal deltas are at most 200 meters per axis. hypot provides center-to-subject floor distance, independent of room translation/yaw; coincident centers yield zero without normalization.

RoomPlacement.swift:281-283 rejects invalid manual room first, then calls actual LightingScene.validated() from Scene.swift. Invalid coordinates/lights, duplicate IDs, invalid optional scene fields, and unsupported or contradictory schemas are rejected before mapping.
